description: Replaced com.azure:azure-identity-extensions:1.2.2 with com.azure.spring:spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql, added spring-cloud-azure-dependencies BOM (version 4.20.0) in dependencyManagement. Spring Boot version is 2.7.18; the skill requires spring-cloud-azure-dependencies >=4.20.0 and <5.0.0 for Spring Boot 2.x, so version 4.20.0 is correct. The BOM is properly scoped as 'import' with type 'pom'. The starter dependency has no explicit version, correctly relying on the BOM for version management.

Migrated from azure-identity-extensions JDBC URL style to Spring Cloud Azure style. The JDBC URL is simplified to only include sslmode=require. Authentication is now configured via spring.datasource.username, spring.datasource.azure.passwordless-enabled=true, spring.cloud.azure.credential.managed-identity-enabled=true, and spring.cloud.azure.credential.client-id. No password is set. Comments for sovereign cloud deployment and service principal authentication are present. All required changes per the migration-mi-postgresql skill are applied correctly.
